parole.significato: A member of a masked secret society of the Tolai, carrying out local extortion and terrorism and dressing in leaves.
parole.testo: Origin unclear, but believed to derive from the Tolai Douk (“cruel”). Possibly related to dekdek (“strong”).

parole.significato: The national currency of Papua New Guinea, divided into 100 toea.
